info.name: Cobrowsing — Annotation (Socket.IO)
info.description:
Socket.IO collection for the annotation / whiteboard relay.

The backend (src/socket/meetingHandler.js) is a PURE PASSTHROUGH relay — it does not store strokes, validate roles, or echo events back to the sender. It rebroadcasts each event to everyone else in the same room.

HOW TO USE
1. Open the 'Annotation Socket' request. Postman opens a Socket.IO connection to {{socketUrl}}.
2. Click 'Connect'.
3. Send 'join-meeting' FIRST — every annotation event is scoped to the joined room (socket.meetingId). Without joining, nothing relays.
4. Open the request in a SECOND tab and connect again to act as the receiving client (join the same meetingId). The sender does NOT receive its own events, so a second connection is required to observe the relay.
5. Send 'whiteboard-draw', 'whiteboard-clear', 'moderator-cursor' from one tab; watch them arrive on the other.

All coordinates are normalized 0-1.

Default socket URL: ws://localhost:5001

variable.description: Socket.IO endpoint. Backend runs on port 5001 (index.js).
Room id (uuid). Both tabs must join the same value.

request.description: Socket.IO connection for the annotation/whiteboard relay. Connect, then send 'join-meeting' before any annotation event. Coordinates normalized 0-1.

originalRequest.description:
EVENT: join-meeting

Must be sent first. Joins socket to the room so subsequent events relay. role: 'moderator' | 'participant'.

EVENT: whiteboard-draw

One line segment. Coords normalized 0-1. mode: 'pencil' | 'eraser' (use size 40 for eraser). Emitted continuously while drawing (~33ms throttle in the client).

EVENT: whiteboard-clear

Clears the whole canvas for everyone else in the room. Payload optional.

EVENT: moderator-cursor

Figma-style live cursor position. Coords normalized 0-1. Throttle ~50ms in the client.
